the letters FD d stand for functional
decomposition diagram a systems analyst
uses an FDD to create a graphical model
of an information system an FDD shows
the system's functions and processes and
how they are
organized sometimes a large structure is
hard to visualize for example a bridge
might look like
this but if you move in for a closer
look you might see this part of the
structure and if you really looked
closely you could see the individual
components and FDD works the same
way so what can you do with an FDD you
can show how a business or information
system is
organized you can indicate where
functions are performed and by
whom you can break a system down into
subsystems and you can show lower level
processes and
subprocesses in part two you'll learn

business functions and
